info.name: Vantage API
info.description: Programmatic access to the Vantage cloud cost management and FinOps platform. Base URL: https://api.vantage.sh/v2. Authenticate with an OAuth2 client-credentials bearer token from console.vantage.sh/account/profile passed as Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_TOKEN.

Return all Recommendations. Use the `type` query parameter with a fuzzy fragment to filter recommendation type case-insensitively (for example: aws, aws:ec2, aws:ec2:rightsizing).

item.name: Get all resources for a recommendation type

request.description: Return all Active Resources associated with recommendations of the specified type.
